name: Mousumi Parida/ ମୌସୁମୀ ପରିଡା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Mousumi Parida writes poetry, short fiction, novels and columns, and also works in translation. Her writing crosses Odia and English: literary records list the English poetry collection The Flute: A Symbol of Love, while Ame Odia publishes her Odia translation of Neeraj Daiya’s story ବିକ୍ରମ ଓ ବେତାଳ.

Her Kabita Live poem ଜୀବନ ଅଷ୍ଟକ gathers eight brief movements around love, betrayal, beauty and waiting. Familiar images become unstable: a lotus carries poison, a mirror breaks, and grief sent away in a paper boat returns with destructive force. The numbered sections allow each scene its own turn, while the recurring contrast between outward beauty and inward hurt holds them together.
